The Bulwark insists its neocon alliances didn't sink Democrats in 2024, scrubbing its own record.
Evidence: Neocon history, denial of data, elite branding
#Aletheia #USPol

Sarah Longwell claims there is zero empirical data showing that partnering with Liz Cheney and former Republicans hurt Democrats in the 2024 election.

Data reveals former GOP operatives whitewash their past damage, shielding their influence over Democrats while ignoring how neocon alliances alienate working-class voters.

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Former GOP operatives whitewash their own catastrophic policy legacy while gaslighting voters about why 2024 went off the rails.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 32.8, z: 4)

- Sarah Longwell / Bulwark: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Denies electoral blowback from neocon alliances.
- Elite Democratic Strategy: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Co-opted by architects of past failure.

The Bulwark has built a thriving media brand catering to liberals by trading on its anti-Trump stance while suppressing its architects' role in creating the very conditions that birthed modern right-wing populism.

The Poison:
Rewriting political history to shield disgraced strategists from accountability lets them institutionalize their failed hawkish ideology within the opposition party.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis mistakes tactical posturing (WHO is speaking) for strategic reality (WHAT policies are being smuggled in), confusing branding for electoral viability.

Social Physics Analysis:
The Bulwark's operatives run a classic Smart Selfish maneuver. They manufacture a moral panic against fascism to obscure their own complicity in past disasters, projecting blame onto critics while extracting elite influence.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. The negative actual will (-0.85) overrides cosmetic opposition pretexts.

The Unavoidable Truth: Neoconservative operatives cannot launder their history of catastrophic foreign and domestic policies simply by switching political teams.

The Unavoidable Lie: The claim that partnering with warmongers has zero electoral cost is contradicted by fundamental working-class alienation.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts to watch people who helped break the world try to style themselves as its saviors, demanding blind loyalty while dismissing the very communities bearing the scars.

Brothekanon:
Wild how former architects of endless wars and disastrous economic policies slide into the Dem party, demand total obedience, and act like pointing out their record is unfair.

Spirithekanon:
"Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves." Matthew 7:15 FAIL

On the defensive, Sarah Longwell says there’s no evidence Democrats’ alliance with Liz Cheney hurt Kamala Harris. Swing-state polling says otherwise.

After my essay and live chat on how the former GOP operatives behind The Bulwark are trying to steer Democrats’ agenda, the news outlet has been scrambling to try to fortify its reputation as experts in winning elections, knowing that is their fraudulent-but-unique selling proposition to liberals.

In the process, founder Sarah Longwell is now trying to rewrite the entire history of the 2024 election, pretending that neocons’ success in influencing the Democrats’ strategy in that contest had no real impact on the outcome — when in fact data suggest it helped deliver the presidency to Donald Trump.

“My problem with the DSA types who are after us is not their political ideology or their opinions,” said Longwell, amid the social media uproar over my essay at The Lever. “Their analysis doesn’t make any sense. There’s not a single piece of empirical data that the Liz Cheney stuff mattered (in 2024).”
